reason: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and with shift schedules at TidalHealth I couldn't count on getting there often enough to make $59 a month worth it. It isn't open yet either, so I'd wait and see.
objection: I'd be paying a monthly fee plus gas for a place I can only get to a few times a month on our schedule. The free library and the park cost nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Pay-as-you-go drop-in with no commitment, or a cheaper membership that has a limited number of visits. A good review from a friend who had been there would help too.
